segments.opening_question_spark: If food is everywhere, why can the same few meals still fail you?
segments.entry_transition: The clue is what those repeated meals actually provide.
segments.body_02: Health also needs vitamins, minerals, protein, and fats.
segments.body_03: Fish and coconut alone may still leave nutrient gaps.
segments.body_04: Over time, those gaps can cause health problems.
segments.body_05: Fresh plants may add nutrients those repeated meals miss.
segments.body_06: Clean drinking water is essential every day.
segments.body_07: Shelter protects you from heat, rain, and storms.
segments.body_08: Injuries or infections can become dangerous without medical care.
segments.body_09: Even perfect nutrition cannot stop normal aging.
segments.optional_closing: Plenty of food helps, but it cannot make you live forever.

issues.quote: Fish and coconut alone may still leave nutrient gaps.
issues.problem: This adds a specific claim about fish and coconut that is not supported by the supplied reference meaning, which only says that eating a few foods can leave nutrient gaps.
issues.suggestion: Keep the claim general, for example: "Eating only a few foods may still leave nutrient gaps."
